name: Zero-hour auto purge (ZAP)
short_description: A Microsoft email protection capability that re-evaluates delivered messages and moves them to junk or quarantine when their verdict later changes to phishing or malware.

There's a backup system called zero-hour autopage, ZAP for short.
Zap continuously scans messages that were already delivered to inboxes.
